_comment: Diagnostic repeated numeric-display renders with MPS allocator telemetry.
command:
cat > tests/_diag_mps_repeat.py <<'PY'
import pathlib
import torch
import algan
import algan.manim as mn
from algan import SMOKE_TEST

def test_repeat(tmp_path):
    for i in range(30):
        with algan.Scene(video_settings=SMOKE_TEST):
            tracker = mn.ValueTracker(0).spawn()
            display = algan.DecimalNumber(0.0).spawn()
            display.add_updater(lambda mob, t: mob.set_value(tracker.get_value()))
            tracker.set_value(5)
            result = algan.Scene.save_video(str(tmp_path / f'numeric_{i}.mp4'), SMOKE_TEST)
        print('MEM', i, torch.mps.current_allocated_memory(), torch.mps.driver_allocated_memory(), flush=True)
        assert result.status == 'rendered'
PY
set +e; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -s -p no:cacheprovider tests/_diag_mps_repeat.py; rc=$?; rm -f tests/_diag_mps_repeat.py; echo RESULT repeat_rc=$rc; exit 0
